name: North Padre Island
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in North Padre Island?
answer_short: Yes. Corpus Christi lets golf carts and NEVs use island streets posted 35 mph or less on North Padre Island. They stay off SH 361 and South Padre Island Drive where it's posted higher.

golf_cart.roads: Island streets posted 35 mph or less

rules.rule: Golf carts and NEVs on island streets posted 35 mph or less

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in North Padre Island?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Whitecap Boulevard?
faq.a: Yes, where it's posted 35 mph or less.
